```{r}
library(RTextTools)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

data(NYTimes)

NYTimes_test <- NYTimes |>
    mutate(Date = dmy(as.character(Date)),
           Year = as.integer(year(Date))) |>
    select(Article_ID, Year) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=Year)) + 
    geom_bar()



    
```
